assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's five curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit: the canonical V2 reconstruction model MHA_SP2_HIMIKO_TOGA_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md (read in full, with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its TG-SUP-01 to TG-SUP-03 sections admit), and the Himiko Toga sections of the villain and antagonist character-state ledger, the relationship-state ledger, the Japanese vocabulary ledger and the character-model readiness index, each read for every Toga entry together with its front matter and current admissibility corrections. All five are repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V42. The readiness index's specialist_ready label and the model's retrospective probe are inputs, not conclusions. The deep readings the model links, the supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit, the source-reverification audit, other characters' models and capability records (including Uraraka's and Twice's) and any anime material are not curated on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them; the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Himiko Toga from the V08:p109-116 introduction and V09:p176-181 forest encounter, through the V13:p115-116 Transform disclosure, V16-V17 Hassaikai secondment, V23-V24 Curious conflict, V27:p148-158 and V28:p114-115 Twice bereavement, V30:p044-077 question to Ochako, V35:p023-039 home and p127-154 confession, V38:p007-021 and p115-123 final-war strategy, to the V39:p073-139 childhood account, reciprocal recognition and total-blood gift, with V42:p114, p155 death confirmation as endpoint and TG-SUP-01 to TG-SUP-03 profile and editorial facts as constraints. Kept as separable states: early League, MLA conflict, bereavement and retaliation, and the terminal encounter; later detail is not moved earlier, and no adult or post-death state exists. No villain-ledger Toga entry covers V10-V12, V14-V15, V18-V22, V25-V26, V29, V31-V34, V36-V37 or V40-V41.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states persistent wants (living without disowning her desire, closeness to people she loves, belonging that does not require complete concealment), an ideal self (an ordinary girl, as she defines it, able to love without being made monstrous) and a feared self (a mask or a useful ideological example), with a named attribution error: a boundary against harm is read as total refusal of her personhood (TG05, TG07; V35:p127-154). Located self-definition supports it: 私も普通に生きるのです (V24:p020-021), 私は トガヒミコとして 生きるのです (V39:p091). Decision policy is stated as relation- and loss-conditioned: affection prompts approach and predatory imitation, trusted belonging supports coordinated risk, bereavement converts attachment into retaliation (V28:p114-115), and scarcity prompts planning (V38:p007-021). Not B: the one formal probe (TG-V01, V38 to V39) missed the decisive action at magnitude, motive was only partial, and the model says confidence that the terminal transition generalizes to an unfamiliar opponent should remain low and that her normative model is not a coherent doctrine. Not D: goals, feared self, the attribution error and the conditioning policies are explicit and repeated across TG01-TG08.

The model separates childhood atypical desire, enforced normality and concealment, League affiliation, Twice bereavement, final-war retaliation and terminal reciprocal care, and forbids back-projection: a V24 or V38 freeze cannot use V39's childhood expansion, childhood Toga gets no League language, a V35 version gets no reciprocal encounter. The villain ledger's V08 entry carries an explicit prospective constraint (family history, blood/love ontology and later relationships not backfilled at V08), and its readiness steps (insufficient/emerging through V17, moderate by V23, strong at V24, specialist_ready at V39) and the readiness index's per-volume tier decisions locate state changes at V24, V27-V28, V30, V35, V38 and V39. Not A: there are no Toga ledger entries for many intervening volumes, and V31-V34 have no Toga ledger entry. Not C: the states are named, ordered, separately evidenced and fenced against later knowledge.

The model gives an explicit register logic: 私, polite です-style forms in strikingly intimate or violent contexts, familiar naming, direct declarations of affection and questions about ordinary life, with warnings not to render every line as childish giggling, not to read formal morphology as moral politeness and not to make the V39 apology an all-purpose absolution speech. Located strings span the registers: 可愛い女の子 ヒミコです and 生きにくいです (V08), 出久くん and 出向して良かったぁ (V16:p182, p185), 私も普通に生きるのです (V24:p020-021), the V27:p157 gratitude to the dying clone, 私は私の為すべき事を and 好きな人の喜ぶ顔が好きだった (V38), そっちの尺度で 私を 可哀想な人間にするな!! (V39:p087), 私が "好き"に 生きられる場所だったの (V39:p118), 私の血 全部あげる and 刺してごめんね / 怒鳴ってごめんね (V39). The vocabulary ledger's V39 voice note requires continuity of voice across hostility, intimacy and apology. Not A: the vocabulary ledger calls its strings and romanizations retrieval aids whose glyphs must be rechecked on the page, TG-V01 rated speech/register only partial, and pronunciation and delivery are outside the model. Not C: the register rule is explicit and attested across several states and partners.

Ordinary behavior is local: the author-described clothing practice (TG-SUP-01: she likes sailor uniforms and discards favored casual clothes, with pleasure and pursuit-evasion functions) and childhood-home memories (V35:p023-039, V39:p073-124). Her claims to an ordinary life (V24, V35 当たり前) are value assertions made in conflict, not observed routine. The model says preference is not universal behavioral permission. Not D: there is no distributed body of enacted low-stakes scenes to analyze.

The model's partner table and the relationship ledger give differentiated, state-bound deltas: Midoriya (recognition delight and 出久くん at V16:p182, confession and category mismatch at V35:p127-154, his consent boundary real though she experiences it as exclusion); Ochako (pseudo-intimacy and predation at V09:p176-181, the moral answer received with ありがとう as receipt not agreement at V30:p044-077, mutual salience and unresolved recognition conflict at V35, unfinished 恋バナ and noticed tears at V38, reciprocal recognition without moral convergence at V39); Twice (reciprocal care and thanks at V27:p148-158, posthumous motive at V28:p114-115); Hassaikai (trust-conditioned withholding of Quirk information while tactically cooperative, V17:p023-028); Curious (narrative possession resisted, V24:p019-027); Dabi (care she calls kind beside his instrumental use, V35:p023-039). TG-V01 rated relationship handling supported. Not A: the Ochako transition exceeded the probe's prediction, and other League members, family and any adult relations are thin or absent. Not C: the conditioning is explicit, partner-specific and repeated.

Direct inner access is located mainly late: the internal 出向して良かったぁ (V16:p185), childhood normalization memories at the vandalized home (V35:p023-039), the joy memory and tears (V38:p115-123), and the extended childhood account, rejection of pity and distinction between the knife of love and the knife of anger (V39:p073-139). Not B: for V08-V17 the set offers mostly surface presentation, the model warns that her affective states cannot be inferred from a smile alone, and TG-V01 rated the emotional trajectory only partial. Not D: the late disclosures are extended, first-person and analyzed for causal separation (atypical desire, abusive response, concealment, chosen violence, present reception).

Located conflict conduct is repeated and constrained: attack within intimate conversational categories (V09:p176-181), infiltration by transformation through ingested blood (V13:p115-116), ambush and opportunism inside a hostile coalition with withheld information (V16:p178-185, V17:p023-028), lethal use of Ochako's form and Zero Gravity against Curious's group (V24:p033-036), the rescue disguise used to isolate Uraraka (V30), the Danger Sense anomaly in the Midoriya attack (V35:p127-154), finite-blood strategy and love-condition instability (V38:p007-021, p115-123). The model's embodiment section binds blood held, forms known, duration and affective conditions. Not A: TG-V01 missed the terminal action at magnitude, copied-Quirk rules beyond the located cases stay OPEN, and the Camie acquisition route is unknown. Not C: tactics, triggers and physical limits are located across V09-V39 with explicit rules.

Located positions: rejection of Curious's ownership of her story (V24:p019-021); asking Ochako what heroes will do with someone like her (V30:p044-077); converting Midoriya's boundary into a judgment that protected people count and she does not, with a sincere 当たり前 claim (V35:p127-154); the V39 break with her own 生存競争 logic, the specific apology and continued refusal of capture (V39:p125-139). The model's PRESERVE / REVISE / REJECT / OPEN list bounds interpretation. Not B: the model says her normative model is not a coherent universal doctrine, most positions are value assertions or relational reactions rather than weighed reasons, and the one decisive ethical choice was the probe's miss. Not D: the positions and the V39 choice are explicit, located and analyzed.

Playful presentation is repeated: the light, cute self-introduction (V08:p109-116), rapid pseudo-intimacy and かわいい evaluation (V09:p176-181), delighted recognition (V16:p182), and cheerful insistence in the model's conditional reconstruction. The model names politeness, play, enthusiasm and disturbing intimacy as her baseline presentation and warns that warmth is not evidence that danger is absent. Not C: no relation-conditioned play or humor policy is analyzed, and play is treated as a presentation entangled with predation rather than as humor. Not E: the playful mode is distributed across several volumes and named as a baseline.

The villain ledger carries Toga entries for V08, V09, V13, V16, V17, V23, V24, V27, V28, V30, V35, V38, V39 and the V42 endpoint, the readiness index adds a V12 presented-Camie note, and the model adds three source-labeled supplemental qualifications. The set does not establish whether she appears in V10-V11, V14-V15, V18-V22, V25-V26, V29, V31-V34, V36-V37 or V40-V41. The vocabulary ledger's strings are retrieval aids, the Camie acquisition route is left unknown, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection. Not C: entries exist for about a third of the volumes, with long unsampled stretches. Not E: each named arc in the model's chronology has located ledger entries.

Affirmative located limits are numerous and independent: warmth does not mean safety (V09:p176-181, TG01); self-definition does not make harm consensual (V24, V35:p141-154); copied Quirks are not universal (V24:p033-036 proves the Uraraka case only; V38:p115-123 she cannot reproduce Toya's or Jin's abilities); impersonated Camie is not real Camie (V13:p115-116, TG-SUP-02); thanks to Ochako is not agreement (V30); Dabi's care stays instrumental on his side (V35:p023-039); the terminal gift is not total reform and coexists with refusal of capture (V39:p125-139, TG-SUP-03); the dreams are Ochako's mediated reception, not posthumous agency (V42). The model's REJECT list (congenital evil, stigma as sufficient excuse, completed universal nonviolence) states them as rules. Not A: several are interpretive bounds rather than tested predictions. Not C: each is located and recorded as a limit.

Explicit freeze rules: V08 prospective constraint; no V39 childhood expansion in a V24 or V38 freeze; no future League language for childhood Toga; no reciprocal encounter for a V35 version; TG-V01 freezes inputs at V38 with the V39 gift, apology and V42 death confirmation excluded. The endpoint is fixed: V39 gives a knowingly fatal transfusion without medical confirmation, and V42:p114, p155 makes death explicit; the readiness index says the dreams are reception evidence, not independent postmortem behavior. Not A: ledger windows are coarse and the unsampled volumes, including V31-V34, carry no Toga entry. Not C: the boundaries are explicit and enforced in the probe.

scenario_readiness.note: The set locates many real formulations and an explicit register logic, but the vocabulary ledger calls its strings retrieval aids whose glyphs must be rechecked on the Japanese page, TG-V01 rated speech/register partial (the exact apology and self-naming were outcome evidence, not predicted), the model puts pronunciation and delivery outside its scope, and it says generated dialogue would be an illustrative prediction, never an attributed quotation. Retrieving located lines is supported; writing new lines would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Toga's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named snapshot, stated explicitly, with whether Twice has died, the blood she holds, the forms she knows, her injuries and what she has learned about the other person fixed for it; V39 childhood detail, the terminal gift and the apology are never moved earlier.
The interlocutor is named and handled as the partner table and relationship ledger give for that snapshot; Midoriya-, Ochako- and Twice-specific responses are not transferred to strangers.

Output describes likely priorities and choices at the model's medium confidence, keeps blood-taking and consent violation as live risks, never renders her as harmless unconventional romance or as reformed, and produces no new quoted dialogue as canon.
No scene is set after her death; dream or apparition speech is never treated as Toga's own behavior.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named living snapshot between V08 and V39: early League (V08-V17), MLA conflict (V23-V24), bereavement and retaliation (V27-V35), or the final war before the V39 terminal encounter; whether Twice has died, whether she holds Twice's blood, and whether the V30 and V35 encounters with Ochako and Midoriya have happened are fixed for that snapshot.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: A League member, Midoriya, Ochako, Dabi, a hostile allied group such as the Hassaikai, a normalizing authority such as Curious, or an unfamiliar hero or civilian, in the relation the partner table and relationship ledger give for that snapshot; liking, trust and perceived rejection are stated.
setting_constraints: Infiltration, coalition or secondment work, combat, flight from pursuit, or a direct recognition conversation
Physical state stated: blood held and its duration, forms known, injuries, and whether the affective condition for copying a Quirk is met
No domestic routine, school life, reciprocal romance, adult life or post-death scene invented

scenario_readiness.note: The model's one conditional reconstruction (League-era Toga before Twice's death, told by someone she likes that affection is welcome but blood-taking without permission is not: likely to seek to understand or contest the boundary as separation, with cheerful insistence that can become dangerous; medium confidence) and its stated conditioning policies (boundary read as rejection, affection to approach and imitation, bereavement to retaliation, scarcity to planning) support narrow novel scenes. Not READY: one medium-confidence reconstruction, a probe that missed the decisive action at magnitude, and the model's warning that generalization to an unfamiliar opponent should stay low. Not NOT_READY: the policies are explicit, triggered and state-separated.

The set offers no enacted low-stakes social scene: ordinary conversation with Ochako is explicitly still unhad at V38 (the relationship ledger records that they still have not had 恋バナ), the model says clothing preference is not universal behavioral permission, and her ordinary-life claims are made in conflict. This bounds the evidence set, not Toga.

Located ethical positions can be retrieved (V24:p019-021, V30:p044-077, V35:p127-154, V39:p125-139), but the one formal probe of exactly this domain, V38 to V39 received recognition, missed the decisive action at magnitude, the model says her normative model is not a coherent universal doctrine, it leaves how much accountability she would have accepted had she survived OPEN, and it says the terminal transition should not be generalized to an unfamiliar opponent. New dilemmas would outrun the evidence. This bounds the evidence set, not Toga's ethics.

conditions: The scene is one-sided attraction, recognition-seeking or response to a boundary from a liked person, in a named living snapshot.
Blood-taking, becoming and consent violation remain live; her attraction is never rendered as harmless or as entitlement to the other person.
No reciprocated romance, dating or adult relationship is invented, and Midoriya's located refusal is preserved as real.
scenario_readiness.note: Unlike most of the cohort, the domain is affirmatively analyzed: blood, becoming and love are fused in her stated phenomenology (V24 恋 and 好き, V30:p044-077), the Midoriya fixation runs from recognition delight (V16:p182) to an open confession and 失恋 (V35:p127-154), and the model's only conditional reconstruction is a liked person setting a blood boundary. Not READY: no reciprocal romantic relationship is ever observed, the probe did not test romance, and the model warns against translating her desire into harmless unconventional romance. Not NOT_READY: one-sided attraction and its failure are located and analyzed with triggers.
The evidence gives her no occupation; League infiltration, secondment and combat work are covered under cross-scenario. This gap says nothing about the character.

known_limits.statement: Playful intimacy and conversational warmth coexist with predation and do not signal that danger is absent: the V09:p176-181 encounter joins cute evaluation with cutting and blood interest, Uraraka and Tsuyu reject the intimacy frame, and the model states warmth is not reliable evidence of safety (TG01).

Her self-authored claim to an ordinary life is sincere but does not make harm consensual or ethically neutral: she reclaims 普通 while using Ochako's form lethally (V24:p019-036), and the 当たり前 claim stands beside the Midoriya attack (V35:p141-154). The model REJECTs stigma as a sufficient excuse for every killing.

Transform reproduces abilities only under located affective and identity conditions: the Zero Gravity reproduction proves the Uraraka case only (V24:p033-036), and she cannot simply reproduce Toya's or Jin's abilities though she loves them (V38:p115-123). Blood is finite and timed (V38:p007-021).

Behavior while transformed belongs to Toga, not the person copied: the presented Camie at the exam is resolved as Toga (V13:p115-116), and the supplements leave the blood-acquisition route unknown (TG-SUP-02).
Her ありがとう after Ochako's answer at V30 marks receipt of the answer, not agreement or relational repair, and seeking the answer does not erase the rescue disguise used to isolate Uraraka.

Midoriya's analogy fails at injury and consent and she experiences his boundary as nonrecognition, converting it into refusal of the world (V35:p127-154); the model states the boundary is real even when she reads it as exclusion.

The V39 total-blood gift reverses her blood relation and comes with specific apologies (刺してごめんね / 怒鳴ってごめんね), but she still refuses capture and assimilation, the apology is not general remorse for all victims, and it is not retroactive rescue of earlier attacks (V39:p125-139; TG08; TG-SUP-03).

Her death is explicit in Ochako's speech (V42:p114, p155); later dream and apparition speech (V42:p146-148, p177-183) is mediated through Ochako and is reception evidence, not posthumous behavior. No adult or post-death Toga exists to reconstruct.

TG-V01 predicted possible help but not a complete fatal blood transfer; the model records an action miss at magnitude and residual surprise, so the decisive terminal choice was not predictable from her earlier state.
The villain ledger carries no Toga entry for V10-V12, V14-V15, V18-V22, V25-V26, V29, V31-V34, V36-V37 or V40-V41; whether and how she acts there is unassessed by this set.
No ordinary routine, school, family-as-adult or leisure scene is analyzed beyond an author-described clothing practice.
The model leaves alternative development under different early care and the accountability she would have accepted had she survived OPEN.
The only formal probe is a retrospective, nonblind chronological holdout; no blind or multi-case validation exists.

Not D: the positions and the V39 choice are explicit, located and analyzed.

Playful presentation is repeated: the light, cute self-introduction (V08:p109-116), rapid pseudo-intimacy and かわいい evaluation (V09:p176-181), delighted recognition (V16:p182), and cheerful insistence in the model's conditional reconstruction. The model names politeness, play, enthusiasm and disturbing intimacy as her baseline presentation and warns that warmth is not evidence that danger is absent. Not C: no relation-conditioned play or humor policy is analyzed, and play is treated as a presentation entangled with predation rather than as humor. Not E: the playful mode is distributed across several volumes and named as a baseline.

The villain ledger carries Toga entries for V08, V09, V13, V16, V17, V23, V24, V27, V28, V30, V35, V38, V39 and the V42 endpoint, the readiness index adds a V12 presented-Camie note, the relationship and vocabulary ledgers add partner-specific and lexical entries for the same arcs, and the model adds nine atoms and three source-labeled supplemental qualifications. Every arc in which she acts, from the V08 introduction to the V42 death confirmation, has located entries. Not B: the set does not establish whether she appears in V10-V11, V14-V15, V18-V22, V25-V26, V29, V31-V34, V36-V37 or V40-V41, the vocabulary ledger's broad ranges and romanized strings are retrieval aids, and the Camie acquisition route is left unknown. Not D: the arcs that carry her behavior are covered with page locators and dedicated analysis, not only distributed mentions. The predecessor's D counted the evaluator's own lack of primary-source inspection and weighed volume coverage more harshly than the comparable Toya record; neither is a property of this evidence.

Affirmative located limits are numerous and independent: warmth does not mean safety (V09:p176-181, TG01); self-definition does not make harm consensual (V24, V35:p141-154); copied Quirks are not universal (V24:p033-036 proves the Uraraka case only; V38:p115-123 she cannot reproduce Toya's or Jin's abilities); impersonated Camie is not real Camie (V13:p115-116, TG-SUP-02); thanks to Ochako is not agreement (V30); Dabi's care stays instrumental on his side (V35:p023-039); the terminal gift is not total reform and coexists with refusal of capture (V39:p125-139, TG-SUP-03); the dreams are Ochako's mediated reception, not posthumous agency (V42). The model's REJECT list (congenital evil, stigma as sufficient excuse, completed universal nonviolence) states them as rules. Not A: several are interpretive bounds rather than tested predictions. Not C: each is located and recorded as a limit.

Explicit freeze rules: V08 prospective constraint; no V39 childhood expansion in a V24 or V38 freeze; no future League language for childhood Toga; no reciprocal encounter for a V35 version; TG-V01 freezes inputs at V38 with the V39 gift, apology and V42 death confirmation excluded. The endpoint is fixed: V39 gives a knowingly fatal transfusion without medical confirmation, and V42:p114, p155 makes death explicit; the readiness index says the dreams are reception evidence, not independent postmortem behavior. Not A: ledger windows are coarse and the unsampled volumes, including V31-V34, carry no Toga entry. Not C: the boundaries are explicit and enforced in the probe.

conditions: Use is illustrative reconstruction of one named living snapshot, never attributed quotation; any line presented as canon is retrieved from a located page, and exact-glyph claims return to the Japanese page.

Register follows the model's rules for that snapshot: 私, polite です-style forms carried into intimate or violent moments, familiar naming of liked people (出久くん from V16:p182), direct declarations of affection and questions about ordinary life; never rendered as uniform childish giggling, and formal morphology is not read as moral politeness.

The partner is one the evidence samples (Midoriya, Ochako, Twice, Dabi, the Hassaikai, Curious); grief and the V39 apology reduce buoyancy without erasing blood, cuteness and love vocabulary, and the specific apology is never expanded into general remorse or used before V39:p125-139.
No speech is generated after her death; dream and apparition lines (V42:p146-148, p177-183, including もっと好きに生きてね) belong to Ochako's mediated experience.
scenario_readiness.note: The evidence constrains generated speech enough for illustrative use: an explicit register logic, located formulations from every capability state (V08, V16:p182, p185, V24:p020-021, V27:p157, V38, V39:p087, p091, p118, p132, p134) and the vocabulary ledger's rule that her voice stays continuous across hostility, intimacy and apology. TG-V01's partial speech result concerns the exact apology and self-naming, which is productive uncertainty about wording, not an unconstrained register. Not READY: exact glyphs must be rechecked on the page, the V27:p157 gratitude survives only in romanization, pronunciation and delivery are outside the model, and ordinary conversation is never sampled. Not NOT_READY: the predecessor treated the model's use bound (illustrative, never quotation) and the vocabulary ledger's retrieval-aid caveat as findings that generation is unsupported; under the owner rulings the first bounds use and the second applies only to the broad ranges and romanized strings it names.

conditions: Chronology is one named living snapshot, split at the located changes: whether Twice is alive, dying (V27:p148-158) or dead (from V28:p114-115), whether she holds Twice's blood (from V35:p023-039), the blood and forms she holds, her injuries and what she has learned about the other person are fixed for it. Her childhood is her own memory at every state; the V39:p125-139 gift and apology are never moved earlier and are not treated as a transferable policy.

The interlocutor is one the partner table and relationship ledger sample for that snapshot (Midoriya, Ochako, Twice, Dabi, a League member, the Hassaikai or Curious); Midoriya-, Ochako- and Twice-specific responses are not transferred to other people.

Transfer to an unsampled comparable person, such as another hero who rejects her or a normalizing authority other than Curious, is a separate, lower-confidence condition: it uses only the stated general policies (a boundary read as rejection, affection prompting approach and imitation, imposed definition resisted) and is labeled as transfer.

Output describes likely priorities and choices at the model's medium confidence, keeps blood-taking and consent violation as live risks and predicts her overreach as well as her care, never renders her as harmless unconventional romance or as reformed, and does not decide in advance whether particular care would override self-preservation when a relationship changes.
No scene is set after her death; dream or apparition speech is never treated as Toga's own behavior.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named living snapshot between V08 and V39:p125: early League (V08-V17), MLA conflict (V23-V24), Twice dying at V27:p148-158, bereavement and retaliation from V28:p114-115 (with Twice's blood held from V35:p023-039), or the final war before the V39 terminal gift; whether the V30 and V35 encounters with Ochako and Midoriya have happened is fixed for that snapshot. Her childhood is part of her knowledge throughout.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: A League member, Midoriya, Ochako, Twice, Dabi, a hostile allied group such as the Hassaikai or a normalizing authority such as Curious, in the relation the partner table and relationship ledger give for that snapshot; liking, trust and perceived rejection are stated. An unsampled comparable person is a separate, lower-confidence transfer.
setting_constraints: Infiltration, coalition or secondment work, combat, flight from pursuit, or a direct recognition conversation
Physical state stated: blood held and its duration, forms known, injuries, and whether the affective condition for copying a Quirk is met
No domestic routine, school life, reciprocal romance, adult life or post-death scene invented

scenario_readiness.note: The model's conditional reconstruction (League-era Toga before Twice's death, told by someone she likes that affection is welcome but blood-taking without permission is not: likely to seek to understand or contest the boundary as separation, with cheerful insistence that can become dangerous; medium confidence) and its conditioning policies (boundary read as rejection, affection to approach and imitation, bereavement to retaliation, scarcity to planning) support bounded novel scenes within sampled relationships. Not READY: when the relationship itself changes, the evidence cannot tell which motive decides (the V39 override is the model's own low-generalization case), and confidence stays medium. Not NOT_READY: the policies are explicit, triggered and state-separated.

The set offers no enacted low-stakes social scene: ordinary conversation with Ochako is explicitly still unhad at V38 (the relationship ledger records that they still have not had 恋バナ), the model says clothing preference is not universal behavioral permission, and her ordinary-life claims are made in conflict. This bounds the evidence set, not Toga.

Located ethical positions can be retrieved (V24:p019-021, V30:p044-077, V35:p127-154, V39:p125-139), but a new dilemma is exactly where the evidence cannot say which consideration decides: the model says her normative model is not a coherent universal doctrine, most positions are value assertions or relational reactions rather than weighed reasons, the one decisive ethical choice (V39) overrode the retaliation-and-survival policy in a way TG-V01 could not anticipate, and the model leaves how much accountability she would have accepted had she survived OPEN. This is insufficiency among competing motives, counted once here and in the overall tier; it bounds the evidence set, not Toga's ethics.

conditions: The scene is one-sided attraction, recognition-seeking or response to a boundary from a liked person, in a named living snapshot.
Blood-taking, becoming and consent violation remain live; her attraction is never rendered as harmless or as entitlement to the other person.
No reciprocated romance, dating or adult relationship is invented, and Midoriya's located refusal is preserved as real.
scenario_readiness.note: Unlike most of the cohort, the domain is affirmatively analyzed: blood, becoming and love are fused in her stated phenomenology (V24 恋 and 好き, V30:p044-077), the Midoriya fixation runs from recognition delight (V16:p182) to an open confession and 失恋 (V35:p127-154), and the model's only conditional reconstruction is a liked person setting a blood boundary. Not READY: no reciprocal romantic relationship is ever observed, the probe did not test romance, and the model warns against translating her desire into harmless unconventional romance. Not NOT_READY: one-sided attraction and its failure are located and analyzed with triggers.
The evidence gives her no occupation; League infiltration, secondment and combat work are covered under cross-scenario. This gap says nothing about the character.

known_limits.statement: Playful intimacy and conversational warmth coexist with predation and do not signal that danger is absent: the V09:p176-181 encounter joins cute evaluation with cutting and blood interest, Uraraka and Tsuyu reject the intimacy frame, and the model states warmth is not reliable evidence of safety (TG01).

Her self-authored claim to an ordinary life is sincere but does not make harm consensual or ethically neutral: she reclaims 普通 while using Ochako's form lethally (V24:p019-036), and the 当たり前 claim stands beside the Midoriya attack (V35:p141-154). The model REJECTs stigma as a sufficient excuse for every killing.

Transform reproduces abilities only under located affective and identity conditions: the Zero Gravity reproduction proves the Uraraka case only (V24:p033-036), and she cannot simply reproduce Toya's or Jin's abilities though she loves them (V38:p115-123). Blood is finite and timed (V38:p007-021).

Behavior while transformed belongs to Toga, not the person copied: the presented Camie at the exam is resolved as Toga (V13:p115-116), and the supplements leave the blood-acquisition route unknown (TG-SUP-02).
Her ありがとう after Ochako's answer at V30 marks receipt of the answer, not agreement or relational repair, and seeking the answer does not erase the rescue disguise used to isolate Uraraka.

Midoriya's analogy fails at injury and consent and she experiences his boundary as nonrecognition, converting it into refusal of the world (V35:p127-154); the model states the boundary is real even when she reads it as exclusion.

The V39 total-blood gift reverses her blood relation and comes with specific apologies (刺してごめんね / 怒鳴ってごめんね), but she still refuses capture and assimilation, the apology is not general remorse for all victims, and it is not retroactive rescue of earlier attacks (V39:p125-139; TG08; TG-SUP-03).

Her death is explicit in Ochako's speech (V42:p114, p155); later dream and apparition speech (V42:p146-148, p177-183) is mediated through Ochako and is reception evidence, not posthumous behavior. No adult or post-death Toga exists to reconstruct.

TG-V01 predicted possible help but not a complete fatal blood transfer; the model records an action miss at magnitude, a partial motive result and residual surprise. The probe shows the model cannot decide in advance whether particular care overrides self-preservation and refusal of capture when recognition changes a relationship.
The villain ledger carries no Toga entry for V10-V12, V14-V15, V18-V22, V25-V26, V29, V31-V34, V36-V37 or V40-V41; whether and how she acts there is unassessed by this set.
No ordinary routine, school, family-as-adult or leisure scene is analyzed beyond an author-described clothing practice.
The model leaves alternative development under different early care and the accountability she would have accepted had she survived OPEN.
The only formal probe is a retrospective, nonblind chronological holdout; no blind or multi-case validation exists. This limits confidence and permitted use; it is not a tier criterion.
